    Set up publishing

    Do this once. Everyone else only ever needs one of the two passwords below.

    A fine grained token for this repo only, with Contents read and write. See SETUP.md for how to create one. It is encrypted below before it goes anywhere.

    Give the first password to anyone who should edit and publish sections. Give the second to anyone who should only be able to leave comments. They must be different.

    Encrypted and active on this device now. To make it work for everyone else, put both lines in index.html:

    const VAULT_EDIT = '...';
    const VAULT_COMMENT = '...';

    They replace the existing const VAULT = '...'; line near the top of the script. Commit and push, and both passwords work for everyone.
